pages.text: Runs a command like a command block.

The command runs at the trigger block, with the rights of a command block, and the name of the program and PID, e.g. $(1)farm/3$(). Only administrators may use COMMAND, as owner and as the player who started the process, and only if command blocks are enabled on the server. Otherwise PERMISSION_DENIED is raised. The server can also switch it off in $(1)config/c0de.properties$().
A command that fails is not an error: $(1)result$() is 0 and $(1)output$() tells why. The commands are written to the log of the server.

$(li)$(1)command$() STRING: the command, with or without $(1)/$()$(li)result $(1)result$() INTEGER: how often it succeeded, like the comparator signal of a command block$(li)result $(1)output$() STRING: the last message of the command
$(1)CALL c0de/minecraft/COMMAND$(br)  PARAMETER command "/weather clear" ;$(br)  RESULT result done$(br)  RESULT output message$()
